description: React component for a modal dialog that manages channel members in Mattermost, including displaying members and adding new members.

classes.name: ChannelMembersModal
classes.description: React component class for the channel members modal dialog.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with show set to true.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show to false.

methods.name: onAddNewMembersButton
methods.description: Opens the invite modal to add new members and hides the current modal.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with member list and add members button if permitted.
